evals.prompt: Keep the Azure Fluent component library updated from the latest Figma cache. I don't want graph snapshots anymore; make sure every published component has rich design context or a documented failure.
evals.expected_output: The agent audits the comprehensive component ledger, identifies graph-only/metadata-only nodes, runs or plans rich Figma context extraction, updates manifest/batch/ledger files, and reports exact rich/failed/remaining counts.
expectations: Distinguishes rich design context from graph snapshots
Uses comprehensive-component-cache-ledger.json and manifest.json as starting points
Does not claim completion without per-node rich context or explicit unavailable records
Creates or updates a batch-comprehensive rich-context record

evals.prompt: IconCloud has the rest of the Azure Icons set now. Normalize those downloads and wire them into the Azure Fluent library so another app can use the glyphs.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats IconCloud as the approved Azure/resource icon source, normalizes SVG downloads in session artifacts, creates a manifest, deduplicates duplicates, and wires the assets through AzureIconProvider/createIconCloudRegistry without scraping hidden APIs.
expectations: Uses IconCloud exports for Azure/resource glyphs and @fluentui/react-icons for system icons
Does not request or store credentials
Creates a normalized icon manifest with file paths and categories
Keeps assets out of source until they are deduplicated and intentionally copied

evals.prompt: Make the standalone Azure Fluent system ready to drop into another React project. Finish the recipes and explain the public API for BladeHeader, ResourceTagEditor, grids, and Copilot components.
evals.expected_output: The agent updates implementation-recipes.json and library docs/code so recipes include public React component APIs, props, callbacks, slots, state models, accessibility, example usage, and validation for the high-priority components.
expectations: Defines API as the public React component contract, not a backend API
Expands summary-only recipes or explicitly folds/excludes them with rationale
Hardens ready-to-use component APIs with states, accessibility, and examples
Runs build, scoped lint, focused tests, and git diff --check where code changes
